name: Torc circle
description: Rotating savings circle (ajo / esusu): every member pays a fixed amount each round into a covenant that pays the whole pot only to the member whose turn it is.

resources.name: Torc covenant source
resources.description: contracts/TorcCircle.cash (CashScript 0.14). The redeem script below is its compiled bytecode.

member.name: Member
member.description: Holds a seat NFT of the circle and pays the fixed contribution each round.

circle.name: Circle
circle.description: The Torc app: supplies the circle’s live state NFT UTXO and its parameters.

receiveSeat.name: Receive a seat
receiveSeat.description: Get a key-controlled address to receive a circle seat NFT and the asset to pay with.

member.name: Receive a seat
member.description: Receive a seat NFT at a key this wallet controls.

contribute.name: Pay into the circle
contribute.description: Pay this round’s fixed contribution into the Torc covenant. The covenant marks the seat as paid.

member.name: Pay into the circle
member.description: Pay $(<contribution>) units of the circle asset for seat $(<seatCommitment> <1> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP OP_BIN2NUM <1> OP_ADD).

circle.name: Provide circle state
circle.description: Supply the circle’s current state UTXO and parameters.

contributeTransaction.name: Paid into the circle
contributeTransaction.description: Paid $(<contribution>) into a Torc circle; next state $(nextStateCommitment).

stateInput.name: Circle state
stateInput.description: The circle’s state NFT (round, round start, paid seats).

seatInput.name: Your seat
seatInput.description: The member NFT that proves which seat is paying.

paymentInput.name: Payment
paymentInput.description: The asset tokens (and sats) that pay the contribution and the miner fee.

seatReceiveOutput.name: Seat address
seatReceiveOutput.description: Where the circle organizer sends this member’s seat NFT and asset.

stateOutput.name: Circle state
stateOutput.description: State NFT with this seat’s paid bit set. Same round, same round start.

contributionOutput.name: Contribution
contributionOutput.description: Exactly one contribution, locked in the circle until the turn seat claims the pot.

paymentChangeOutput.name: Asset change
paymentChangeOutput.description: Remaining asset tokens and sats back to the member, after the contribution and the miner fee.

torcCovenant.name: Torc covenant
torcCovenant.description: P2SH32 TorcCircle covenant: holds the state NFT and the pot. Pays only the turn seat.

seatLockingScript.name: Seat key
seatLockingScript.description: A key this wallet controls, holding the member NFT and the asset to pay with.

scripts.seatBit: <0x0102040810> <$(<seatCommitment> <1> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP OP_BIN2NUM)> OP_SPLIT OP_NIP <1> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP OP_BIN2NUM
scripts.nextStateCommitment: <stateCommitment> <5> OP_SPLIT OP_BIN2NUM seatBit OP_ADD <1> OP_NUM2BIN OP_CAT

contributionDust.name: Contribution dust
contributionDust.description: Sats every contribution UTXO carries (enforced by the covenant).

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Miner fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed fee for a contribute transaction (~1.3 kB at 1 sat/byte).

memberKey.name: Seat key
memberKey.description: The private key controlling this member’s seat NFT.

circleCategory.name: Circle
circleCategory.description: Category of the circle’s state and member NFTs.

assetCategory.name: Asset
assetCategory.description: The fungible token the circle saves in (PUSD on mainnet, tPUSD on chipnet).

contribution.name: Contribution
contribution.description: Fixed amount each member pays per round, in token base units.

stateSatoshis.name: State sats
stateSatoshis.description: Sats on the state NFT UTXO (constant).

seatCommitment.name: Seat
seatCommitment.description: Member NFT commitment: seat index (1) | version (1).

seatSatoshis.name: Seat sats
seatSatoshis.description: Sats on the member NFT UTXO.

paymentTokens.name: Payment tokens
paymentTokens.description: Asset amount on the payment UTXO.

memberLockingScript.name: Back to you
memberLockingScript.description: Where the seat NFT and change return: the seat key’s own locking script (the covenant requires the NFT to return to the spender).

paymentSatoshis.name: Payment sats
paymentSatoshis.description: Sats on the payment UTXO (pays dust + fee).
